reviews.comment: Tough class with TONS of reading that if you don't do, you will 100% fail. However, she is VERY accessible and easy to talk to outside of class and she makes it very clear from the first day that she loves giving out A's and would be happy to do so if you put in the work. Gives out tons of extra credit too. DO NOT EVER FORGET TO READ.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Mandatory class but will count class as EC if show up is low. Hard grader but becomes easier over semester. Readings r nice bc u learn material/subjects covered in tests/quizzes. She does not tolerate laziness in any form, and makes this clear-- If you show ur trying shes always willing to help. All in all, great prof 10/10 loved her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The professor is nice but strict about no electronics. Her slides are really simplified, so you really have to pay attention to her when taking notes. The class is easy if you're familiar with regressions and good at reading. Weekly field experiment readings are key for the summaries, which aren't graded harshly but are crucial for exam prep.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You will regret not reading. I never read for any class and normally don't regret it, so take this seriously. Sometimes makes fun of students if she thinks we are making silly mistakes (she was not entirely wrong). Otherwise: good lecturer, straightforward exams and quizzes, very reasonable grader.

reviews.comment: Lots of reading. take the summaries seriously. I did not cause i thought not much points on these but every point counts. I don't think book necessary.Attend the class and participate. Class is super small. She is nice and you will learn a lot from this class thats necessary. presentation and public speaking is required. She helps with projects.

reviews.comment: Dr. Danila Serra is very mean and arrogant. She asked students to do a lot of work but complained she doesn't have time to evaluate. Gave very bad scores.

A great professor and a great class where you will learn a lot. 441 is a fairly challenging and demanding course. You will have to read and summarize two economics papers and take one quiz per week, but most of your grade will come from the midterm, the final, and a project.

reviews.comment: Dr. Serra loves the work she does and she's open to working with you and helping you out with anything. We had a quiz + 2 paper summaries every week. It got easier as the semester went by. The fact that we had so many quizzes kept me on top of the material so I didn't have to study a lot for exams. I definitely recommend taking this class!
